catalog.name: vertical_bounce
catalog.applicability: A passive vertical drop and repeated ball-floor contacts ONLY. Resting at the end is OK; active dribbling, rolling, slopes, prescribed contact timestamps and other actions are not covered.

catalog.name: single_impact
catalog.applicability: Exactly one isolated strike/contact against a stationary surface. No repetitions, continuous scraping, rolling, ringing sequence, or other subsequent action. Normal impulse only; material deformation and contact duration are not predicted.
